svg.title: Three streams after the value decision
svg.desc: A comparison of the three parallel streams after Executive Validation, with their typical owners: feasibility and validation, owned by the SE with the customer's technical owner; security and IT review, owned by the customer's security team with Glean support; and the commercial and paper process, owned by the AE with procurement.
